Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lot as a pickup at the treasure part (an asset). Taking it awards the lot. Field meanings follow Elden Ring's layout; there is no executable to confirm them.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, an Asset in retail. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLotID.Wiki: The ItemLotParam row given by the treasure.

ActionButtonID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for the pickup prompt, or -1 for the default. Retail uses -1, or 4211 on a few treasures.

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The player animation played when taking the pickup, or -1 for the normal one. -1 on every retail treasure.

InChest.Wiki: What holds the pickup, not a bool. 0 on most retail treasures, else 2 or 3 (in Elden Ring 2 is an item glow).

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it. Off on every retail treasure.

Unk42.Wiki: Off on every retail treasure. In Nightreign it enables an extra check with Unknown: 0x48.
